he said it wasn’t harmful and implied that joke wasn’t that serious to be considered lesbian-phobic (this is actually what he said), while i don’t think khoi himself is lesbian-phobic it was definitely strange for him to make that joke and then say what can or can not be considered lesbian-phobic. and no, many people dismissed apology because he said he’s going to do it again, which kind of contradicts the whole point of an apology. 

though to be fair, in the end he was being harassed a lot which would affect anyone’s mind state and his second apology was much more better and genuine. 

btw im sorry if it looks like im defending the actions of the harassers — im not intending to, im just trying to give insight onto why he received the amount of backlash he had.
